# Week 1
## Upper A
build / used: none / 3x8 / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
iso / used: none / 2x12 / 60s / progress: dp(2.5lb, 12, 15)
bw / used: none / 3x6 / 0lb / 60s / warmup: none / progress: custom() {~
  if (completedReps >= reps && reps[1] < 12) {
    reps += 1
  }
~}

// No bench? Press from the floor.
Bench Press, Dumbbell / ...build / 30lb
Bent Over One Arm Row / ...build / 30lb
Shoulder Press / ...build / 20lb
Pullover / ...build / 25lb
Lateral Raise / ...iso / 10lb
Bicep Curl / ...iso / 15lb
Skullcrusher, Dumbbell / ...iso / 15lb

## Lower A
Goblet Squat / ...build / 30lb
Single Leg Deadlift / ...build / 25lb
Lunge, Dumbbell / ...build / 20lb
Single Leg Glute Bridge Straight Leg / ...bw
Standing Calf Raise / ...iso / 30lb
Dead Bug / ...bw

## Upper B
// Hands on a table or a bench.
Incline Push Up / ...bw
// Hold a door frame, or a towel looped round a post, lean back and pull.
Vertical Row / ...bw
Bent Over Row, Dumbbell / ...build / 25lb
Chest Fly / ...iso / 15lb
Reverse Fly / ...iso / 10lb
Hammer Curl / ...iso / 15lb
Triceps Extension / ...iso / 15lb

## Lower B
